newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 10-mth oil production down 67 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 10-mth oil production down 67 percent.

text.p: The Department of Energy (DOE) said on Wednesday Philippine oil production for the first nine months dropped 67 percent to 271,623 barrels of oil from 822,088 barrels during the same period last year.

Ismael Ocampo, DOE oil and gas chief, told Reuters the drop was due to the continued stoppage of production from the West Linapacan oil field in the southwestern island of Palawan, the country's biggest oil producing field.

Gas production from the only producing natural gas field, the San Antonio field in the northern province of Isabela, rose by 59.10 percent at 310.547 million cubic feet from last year's 195.183 million cubic feet.
